name: Cyber Kill Chain & Pyramid of Pain
command: # Kill Chain: Recon → Weaponize → Deliver → Exploit → Install → C2 → Action on Objectives
description: Lockheed Martin's 7-phase Cyber Kill Chain and the Pyramid of Pain — two foundational frameworks for understanding attacker TTPs and prioritizing defensive responses.
notes:
Cyber Kill Chain phases:
1. Reconnaissance — OSINT, scanning, social engineering targets.
2. Weaponization — Build exploit + payload (malware, malicious doc).
3. Delivery — Email phishing, drive-by download, USB drop.
4. Exploitation — Trigger vulnerability, execute payload.
5. Installation — Establish persistence (registry, service, scheduled task).
6. Command & Control (C2) — Beacon to attacker-controlled infra.
7. Actions on Objectives — Exfiltration, encryption, lateral movement.

Pyramid of Pain (hardest IOC to change at top, easiest at bottom):
[Top]  TTPs (hardest — changing forces attacker to retool)
       Tools (binaries, RATs)
       Network/Host Artefacts (registry keys, mutexes)
       Domain Names
       IP Addresses
[Base] Hash Values (trivial recompile = new hash)

Detector takeaway: push detections up the pyramid. Hash-only detections are easily evaded; TTP-based detections (Sigma, YARA) survive recompilation.
